executive_tldr: The dry bulk market is experiencing a correction, driven by slowing cargo demand and increasing vessel availability.
A long spread position in the dry bulk sector versus the tanker sector is recommended, with a focus on the Capesize and Panamax segments.
The upcoming monthly customs commodity trade data and the US weekly EIA petroleum status reports are the key catalysts to watch in late August and September 2026.

tanker.summary: The tanker market is currently experiencing a bull confluence, with a Z-score of +0.81σ and a ROC60 of +11.3%, indicating a strong uptrend. The clean-dirty spread is also supportive of this thesis, with the dirty tanker segment outperforming the clean segment.
